title: Distributivity, affineness, and the structure sheaf
summary: We observe that for a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme the structure sheaf generates the perfect complexes if and only if the lattice of thick subcategories is distributive if and only if the affinization map is 0-affine. Examples are discussed, including an example of a quasi-projective scheme which is not quasi-affine but for which these equivalent conditions hold.
